title: Welcome screen loads and shows primary call-to-action
description: Verifies the onboarding welcome screen renders and shows the Continue action for new users.

title: Continue from Welcome navigates to Email Entry
description: Verifies tapping Continue from the welcome screen takes the user to the email entry step.

title: Continue is not duplicated and remains usable after a scroll
description: Verifies the Continue control remains available and functional after scrolling the welcome screen.

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page

title: Rapid repeated taps on Continue do not break navigation
description: Verifies repeated Continue taps do not result in an error state and the user ends on email entry.

title: Welcome screen does not show authenticated-only onboarding steps
description: Verifies the welcome screen does not expose later onboarding steps (account basics/sport selection) before email entry.

Verify text "Sport selection" is not visible

title: Successful email submission navigates to email verification screen
description: Verifies that entering a valid email and submitting proceeds to the email verification screen.

title: Invalid email format shows inline validation error
description: Verifies that an improperly formatted email is rejected with a visible validation message and does not proceed.

title: Empty email submission shows required-field validation
description: Verifies that submitting with an empty email shows a required/empty error message.

title: Whitespace-only email is rejected
description: Verifies that an email consisting of only spaces is treated as invalid and shows a visible error.

title: Email with leading/trailing spaces is accepted after trimming
description: Verifies that a valid email with surrounding spaces can still be submitted and proceeds to verification.

steps.description: Type "  spaced.user@example.com  " into the email field

title: Supabase signUp failure shows a visible API error message
description: Verifies that when the sign-up request fails, the user sees a clear error message and remains on the email entry screen.

title: Resubmitting after an error can succeed and proceeds to verification
description: Verifies that after an API error is shown, the user can change the email and successfully submit to reach verification.

title: Attempt sign-in with invalid credentials and verify user stays on login
